findings.claim: Western Energy Imbalance Market coordinates real-time electricity exchange across Western participants; market membership alone is not surplus or a transmission guarantee.
IEA July 2026 report connects sulfur shipping disruption to fertilizer and mineral-processing acid constraints; its July description does not establish September 21 strait status.
IEA 2025 report identifies purified phosphoric acid as an LFP battery input and concentrated processing; no evidence from this that batteries caused present fertilizer curtailments.

A replacement can lower one recurring dependency and increase another, while removing useful coproducts. Each transition needs a preserved-function test, new-dependency test and replacement readiness gate.

Four RC-002 prose fields contain individual characters from list/string extension. Original text is recoverable; RC-003 will reassemble it without changing the historical committed cycle. A validator and admission regression test now block recurrence.
